providers.authentication: No credentials required for successful GET.
providers.reuse: Publisher declares CC-BY; attribution Landesamt für Gesundheit und Soziales. Exact license version not specified by this CSV record.
providers.rateLimits: No published quota verified; one shared CSV fetch, never one fetch per site.
providers.coverage: Dated site sampling, temperature, E. coli, enterococci, cyanobacteria field and textual advice; not continuous measurements. Numeric advice fields and forecasts are separate from samples.
providers.freshness: All selected samples September 8–10, 2026; season May 15–September 15. Retrieval time is not sample time. No exact time or timezone offset in Dat.
schemaHazards: Decimal commas; semicolon CSV with quoted links.
Preserve less-than comparators: <15 is not 15 and not zero.
Farb_ID and FARB_ID are different columns; do not case-fold headers.
Grunewaldturm B330 has Temp=0, Eco=0, Ente=0 while Weitere_Hinweise explicitly says construction prevented sampling; do not report these as observed zeros.
Profil is a regional grouping: Kleiner Müggelsee appears under Großer Müggelsee. Do not use Profil alone to establish same water body.
activationPrerequisites: Define/test missing-observation semantics and every displayed advice code; do not derive safe swimming from bacterial values alone.
Carry day precision and per-site sample dates through normalization/API/UI; source-wide newest date cannot freshen older samples.
Keep station position and catalogue distance visible; Schlachtensee sample differs by about 740 m, Krumme Lanke about 490 m. Identity is exact but sample is not at the catalogue point.
Add shared collector and schema-compatible transactional bindings only after adapter and UI freshness tests; no unused source row inserted.

providers.scope: Annual EU rating and waterbody characteristics; no sample timestamp in WFS; not current clearance.
